title: Generalised projective integration scheme in equation-free multiscale modelling
summary: When the spectrum of a system varies significantly over time, fixed choices of macro-, meso-, and micro-time steps, as well as burst lengths, become inadequate, necessitating adaptive and locally informed strategies. To address these challenges, this article proposes a novel and flexible generalised projective integration (GPI) scheme, designed to accommodate time-dependent spectral variation and dynamically evolving scale separation.
